elara_intro.speaker: Warden Elara Thorne
lines: The Hollow Court has been sealed longer than anyone in Greymere can remember.
If that seal has opened, do not assume what is inside has been waiting peacefully.
Stay away from the north arch. That is not a request I enjoy repeating.

mira_intro.speaker: Mira Solen
lines: The official records say the Court is empty.
Which usually means the interesting records are somewhere we are not allowed to read.
If you do go down there... I want to hear everything.

notice_board.speaker: Royal Notice
lines: BY ORDER OF THE CROWN OF AVELAINE:
Unsanctioned Crest possession, use, or study is forbidden under the Veiled Accord.
Resonance events must be reported to Warden Thorne without delay.
The door is barred from the inside. Greymere keeps early nights.
The south road runs toward Veyrhold.
Whatever is happening at the Hollow Court feels more urgent than leaving town.
The ancient arch stands open. Cold air drifts up from the dark below.
The seal on the Hollow Court is broken.

court_entrance.speaker: Warden Elara Thorne
lines: Wait. If you are going in regardless, you will not do it alone.
Mira — stay behind me. And you: touch nothing that hums.

court_entrance.speaker: Mira Solen
lines: Everything down there hums, Warden. That is rather the point.
The Hollow Court is silent now. The dormant Crest below still remembers you.

post_battle.speaker: Warden Elara Thorne
lines: Everyone still standing? Good.
Those were not looters. Someone sent them, and they knew the seal would be open.
This goes to Veyrhold. All of it — including what that Crest just did.

post_battle.speaker: Mira Solen
lines: It answered you. Crests are not supposed to answer anyone anymore.
...What exactly did you touch down there?

toby_flavor.speaker: Toby
lines: Ma says I'm too young to go near the Court. I say I'm too young to muck out the goat pen either, but here we are.
You're not going up there, are you? To the arch?

wren_flavor.speaker: Wren
lines: Feverbalm, willowbark, a little dried nettle for the swelling. Nothing fancy, but it keeps Greymere on its feet.
Warden Thorne came through here last week smelling of Court dust. Didn't like that one bit.

kassian_flavor.speaker: Elder Kassian
lines: I was younger than you when they sealed that arch. My grandfather was younger than me.
Three generations of Greymere folk have grown up being told not to ask what's under the Court.
Strange, how well that worked, right up until it didn't.

pell_flavor.speaker: Pell
lines: Barley's coming in thin this year. Everyone says it's the weather.
Everyone's been saying it's the weather since that light came out of the Court, funnily enough.

guard_flavor.speaker: Town Guard
lines: Move along toward Veyrhold if you're heading out — I'm not paid to make conversation, I'm paid to watch that road.
And the arch. Mostly the arch, if I'm honest.

watchman_flavor.speaker: Watchman Orrin
lines: I've stood under this arch every day for six years. Never once had to do anything about it.
Warden Thorne changed my watch orders last week. Didn't say why. Didn't like that either.

senna_flavor.speaker: Goodwife Senna
lines: Kassian's told you the arch story already, hasn't he. He tells everyone the arch story.
It's a good story. Doesn't mean it's the whole one.

ferris_flavor.speaker: Old Ferris
lines: Someone's got to keep the lamps lit and walk the rounds. Forty years now, give or take.
Quiet town, Greymere. I intend to keep it that way as long as this torch holds out.
The hooded figure says nothing. It does not appear to be waiting for anything in particular.
Or perhaps it is waiting for exactly the right thing.
